d: In this first episode of Pompeii: Out of Time from National Geographic, join Tom Hiddleston as he traces the stories of real Roman citizens through the volcanic eruption as the tremors first begin. As Mount Vesuvius begins to stir, Tom Hiddleston asks a crucial question: Will anyone recognize the warning signs in time? Following a teenage apprentice and a formidable businesswoman, he uncovers a city carrying on as earthquakes intensify. With the clock already ticking, Tom investigates why people ignore danger and whether these first decisions sealed their fate amid one of history's worst…
